uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: AI sales tools serve the scheduled video-call motion: bot joins, transcript appears.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: Field selling is structurally invisible to the meeting-bot stack — the highest-value conversations happen where no bot can join.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: A tool built for calendar invites cannot follow a rep into a lunch, a site visit, or a car.
